scenarios.name: Return to the notes list from a text note
scenarios.reason: Back produced the launcher, not the expected notes list; retrying is forbidden.
scenarios.diagnosis: The note editor does not handle the Android Back action as a return to the notes list. The app is put in the background instead.
scenarios.suggestion: Handle Android Back in the note editor by saving as needed and returning to the notes list, matching the editor's on-screen back control.

steps.remark: click: Clicking Next to open the notes list
wait: PRIMARY: confirm no Android permission prompt is present
click: Clicking Create new text note button
type: Typing Milk into the note title field
type: Typing into the note body field
analyze: the on-screen keyboard is visible
press_key: PRIMARY: press the Android system Back key once from the visible note editor
wait: Waiting stop because Android system Back opened the launcher instead of returning to the notes list
